links.comparator_used: GPT-3.5, GPT-4 (training knowledge alone) and Microsoft's Prometheus, on 19 DLBCL questions rated by eight reviewers
links.outcome: Reviewer-rated accuracy and relevance (3-point scale); hallucination frequency
links.effect: RAG model had higher average scores and the most top scores across questions on accuracy and relevance. GPT-4 was closer to RAG on relevance than on accuracy. GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 had more answers with hallucinations (non-existent references, inaccurate clinical answers) than the other LLMs. No numeric scores are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: RAG did not lead on readability: GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 had the highest readability scores.
links.quote: On accuracy and relevance, the RAG model outperformed other models with higher scores on average and the most top scores across questions.
